answer: A farm faking 379 aliases needs 379 separate transcription records, each built over years, so the cost multiplies per alias instead of staying flat. Braille transcriber certification with transcription record is the check: books transcribed under one certificate for years. The falcon check is what stops the copy-paste farm: The record is checked live against the issuer each epoch, and a missing or revoked entry loses the seat. The crystal record is public, the dune cost is per identity, and 379 aliases cost 379 times one honest seat.
